requirement_or_claim: The model covers the 18 dated inventory classes while preserving covered/planned/open distinctions.
Diagram quality relates to generated-code behaviour in bounded sequence-diagram experiments.
Author-less repair can pass gates while preserving or inventing wrong semantics.
Author participation improved reported repair outcomes in a bounded with-author arm.
Upstream errors can enter dependent artefacts, implementation and tests.
Shared wrong premises can make tests and code agree, concealing errors.
Impact can grow through reach, detection delay, correction scope and operational exposure.
Independent validation and outcome-led correction can interrupt the cascade.
Gate burden can increase waiting, batching and bypass.
Quality interventions may affect each DORA metric through different conditional paths.
All nine quality elements matter, while inventory coverage is uneven.
The model should support participatory systemic design and sustained learning.
